final: WITH m AS (SELECT mt.Name AS name, AVG(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN t.Bytes*1.0/t.Milliseconds END) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId=t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), o AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS a FROM m WHERE rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(m.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(m.cnt) AS avg_track_count, AVG(m.rate - o.a) AS avg_excess FROM m, o WHERE m.rate > o.a
